title: Remember Your Creator

questions.question: Remember also your Creator in the days of your what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 12:1 (ESV): "Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth,"

questions.question: Before the evil days come and the years draw near of which you will say, "I have no..." what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 12:1 (ESV): "of which you will say, 'I have no pleasure in them';"

questions.question: And the dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to whom?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 12:7 (ESV): "and the spirit returns to God who gave it."

questions.question: Vanity of vanities, says the Preacher; all is what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 12:8 (ESV): "Vanity of vanities, says the Preacher; all is vanity."

questions.question: Fear God and keep his commandments, for this is the whole duty of whom?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 12:13 (ESV): "Fear God and keep his commandments, for this is the whole duty of man."

questions.question: Remember Him before the silver cord is snapped, or the golden bowl is what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 12:6 (ESV): "before the silver cord is snapped, or the golden bowl is broken,"

questions.question: The Preacher sought to find words of delight, and uprightly he wrote words of what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 12:10 (ESV): "and uprightly he wrote words of truth."

questions.question: The words of the wise are like goads, and like nails firmly fixed are the collected what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 12:11 (ESV): "and like nails firmly fixed are the collected sayings;"

questions.question: Of making many books there is no end, and much study is a weariness of the what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 12:12 (ESV): "and much study is a weariness of the flesh."

questions.question: For God will bring every deed into judgment, with every secret thing, whether good or what?
Before the sun and the light and the moon and the stars are what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 12:2 (ESV): "before the sun and the light and the moon and the stars are darkened"

questions.question: And the grinders cease because they are few, refers to what body part?
And one rises up at the sound of a bird, and all the daughters of song are brought what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 12:4 (ESV): "and all the daughters of song are brought low—"

questions.question: They are afraid also of what is high, and terrors are in the what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 12:5 (ESV): "they are afraid also of what is high, and terrors are in the way;"

questions.question: The grasshopper drags itself along, and desire fails, because man is going to his eternal what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 12:5 (ESV): "because man is going to his eternal home,"

key_verse_text: The end of the matter; all has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments, for this is the whole duty of man.
